title: The King of Fighters '97 (Japan): expansion-RAM compatibility
summary: Supply 1 MB expansion RAM and NOP the guarded instruction loaded from this exact image.
rationale: The old callback takes its 1 MB branch only when 06066F80=2122D110 and 06066FC0=23301FF0. Both words load from FAD 359 in the verified T-3121G V1.001 image; the full-sector CRC preserves that branch guard. An explicit-1-MiB comparison observed the edit load at frame 564. A later 12,000-frame interpreter control executes the exact compiled callback and helper at the original menu addresses and matches all 201 sampled video/audio checkpoints. That control uses a synthetic pre-program caller and preselected expansion RAM; full paired-menu integration and physical cartridge behavior remain unqualified. The separate 4 MB branch and T-4401G route remain in the menu.

writes.effect: Carry the original 1 MB KOF 97 branch instruction NOP.
writes.reason: Preserve the guarded original callback behavior for the exact first-read source.
